description: This is the DEVELOPER own Neblla account, not an end user of their app — to sanction a user use neblla_set_ban_status instead. For safety the MCP never deletes accounts directly. Returns a URL for the user to visit and confirm deletion from the Neblla dashboard. Deleting it deletes every app of theirs as neblla_delete_app does (users, saves, purchases, subscriptions, domains) and their Neblla billing in Stripe; their own Stripe account and Play listings stay theirs to close. Make sure they know before sending them there.
name: neblla_delete_account
title: Delete account
